promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.

questions.explain: 'Der Heiligabend' is 'Christmas Eve' (24 December); 'Silvester' is New Year's Eve.

questions.q: How do you say 'I do sport to keep fit'?
options: Ich treibe Sport, weil ich fit bin
Ich treibe Sport, um dick zu werden
Ich treibe Sport, um fit zu bleiben
Er treibt Sport, um fit zu bleiben
questions.explain: 'Sport treiben' = 'to do sport' and 'um... fit zu bleiben' = 'in order to keep fit'; 'ich treibe' is the correct form.
'Das Schlagzeug' means 'the drum kit' (from 'schlagen' = to hit).

options: To fall into a bad mood
questions.explain: 'In Ohnmacht fallen' means 'to faint'; 'die Ohnmacht' here means 'a faint'.
'Silvester' means 'New Year's Eve' (31 December).
'Spannend' means 'exciting/gripping', e.g. of a film or book.
'Abnehmen' means 'to lose weight'; 'zunehmen' means 'to put on weight'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I spend too much time online'?
options: Ich verbringe zu viel Geld online
Ich verbringe zu viel Zeit online
questions.explain: 'Zeit verbringen' = 'to spend time' and 'zu viel' = 'too much', so this means 'I spend too much time online'.

questions.q: How do you say 'Smoking is harmful to health'?
options: Rauchen ist gut für die Gesundheit
Rauchen ist schädlich für die Gesundheit
questions.explain: 'Schädlich' = 'harmful' and 'für die Gesundheit' = 'for health', so this is correct.
'Der Schlaf' means 'sleep'; 'schlafen' = 'to sleep'.
'Wandern' means 'to hike/ramble' (a planned walk), not to 'wander' aimlessly.

questions.q: How do you say 'On my birthday we eat cake'?
options: An meinem Geburtstag essen wir Suppe
An meinem Geburtstag backen wir kein Brot
An meinem Geburtstag essen wir Kuchen
questions.explain: 'Der Geburtstag' = 'birthday' and 'der Kuchen' = 'cake'.
'Die Freizeit' means 'free time / leisure time'.
'Vermeiden' = 'to avoid' and 'Süßigkeiten' = 'sweets', so this is 'I avoid sweets'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'We decorate the Christmas tree'?
questions.explain: 'Schmücken' = 'to decorate' and 'der Weihnachtsbaum' = 'the Christmas tree'.
'Das Tor' means 'the goal' (also 'gate'); 'ein Tor schießen' = 'to score a goal'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I go swimming twice a week'?
options: Ich gehe zweimal pro Woche schwimmen
Ich gehe zweimal pro Woche tanzen
Ich gehe zweimal pro Monat schwimmen
Ich gehe einmal pro Woche schwimmen
questions.explain: 'Zweimal pro Woche' = 'twice a week' and 'schwimmen' = 'to swim'.

questions.q: What does 'Ich lese normalerweise abends' mean?
options: I used to read in the evenings
I will read in the evenings
I have to read in the evenings
I usually read in the evenings
questions.explain: 'Normalerweise' means 'usually' and 'abends' = 'in the evenings', so this is 'I usually read in the evenings'.
'Angeln' means 'to fish/go angling' (from 'die Angel' = fishing rod).

questions.q: How do you say 'I play football'?
questions.explain: 'Fußball spielen' = 'to play football'. 'Klavier spielen' would be 'to play piano'.
'Sich entspannen' means 'to relax' (the opposite of 'sich anspannen').

questions.q: How do you say 'I do exercise to stay fit'?
options: Ich esse Pommes, um fit zu bleiben
Ich treibe Sport, um fit zu sein
Ich treibe Sport, um fit zu bleiben
Ich treibe Sport, um müde zu werden
questions.explain: 'Sport treiben' = 'to do sport/exercise' and 'um fit zu bleiben' = 'in order to stay fit'.
